goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester tried to grab gear from the locker room racks (Axe, Extinguisher) and the Hose from the truck reel. Every interact returned 'held, not triggered', so the backpack stayed empty. It ran out of steps without putting out a fire, rescuing anyone or refilling water. The round itself was running: the probe shows fires spreading and NPCs toasted, with no server errors.

bugs.title: Gear prompts (Grab Axe, Grab Extinguisher, Grab Hose) never trigger, so no tool can be obtained
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 3 and 4: GearRack1 'Grab Axe' at 3-4 studs, in range, by path and by key E, all returned 'held, not triggered'. Step 5: GearRack2 'Grab Extinguisher' gave the same result. Steps 8 and 9: Reel 'Grab Hose' at about 6 studs (flagged as 2.9 studs from the Reel) gave the same result. Carrying stayed "" and the backpack stayed empty throughout. This blocks firefighting, rescue and refill entirely.

bugs.title: HUD fire and rescue counters disagree with world state
bugs.evidence: Playtester notes: the HUD showed FIRES LEFT 29, then 7, then 0, while world.instance.fires was 0 and no Burning objects were nearby. RESCUED showed 0 / 5 while the round was Active with 119s left. Probe counters show fires_ignited=3 but fires_spread=70, so the HUD value is unreliable.

bugs.title: Mission ID mismatch between world and instance
bugs.evidence: Playtester notes: World.MissionId is 'City' while instance.missionId is 'house_fire'. Fires were still charring parts in the School district while instance.fires was 0.

bugs.title: Inconsistent truck owner labels on prompts
bugs.evidence: Playtester notes: prompts say "hogrider's Truck" while the Reel prompt says 'Fire Truck 67' (step 8 shows 'Grab Hose Fire Truck 67').

bugs.title: Fire tick exceeds its time budget
bugs.evidence: Probe counter fire_tick_over_budget=18, with fires_spread=70 and n_warnings=1. Possible performance problem in the fire simulation.
